summary: Check database sizes with `psql -c '\l+'` and ensure enough space, then on the gateway node test connectivity with `psql ... -c 'SHOW server_version;'`, dump each component with `pg_dump -h <pg_hostname> -U <user> -d <db> --clean --create -Fc -f <component>/<component>.pgc` and append `<component>_pg_database: <name>` to `secrets.yml`.
questions: How do I dump the AAP databases for migration?
How do I check AAP database size?

answer_card.title: Dump each component database
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
psql -c '\l+'   # check sizes first
cd /tmp/backups/artifact
psql -h <pg_hostname> -U <component_pg_user> -d <database_name> -t -c 'SHOW server_version;'
pg_dump -h <pg_hostname> -U <component_pg_user> -d <component_pg_name> \
  --clean --create -Fc -f <component>/<component>.pgc
echo "<component>_pg_database: <database_name>" >> secrets.yml
```
Repeat for controller, gateway and hub.
